title: The Tiny Man and the She-Snow Leopard (ORIGINAL)
description: The victim of foul sorcery, you’ve been shrunk to a mere 5 inches tall. Wandering, you are discovered by a she-snow leopard. This voluptuous cat-woman has plans to make you her toy. My living sex toy. Hey! You're awake. What even are you anyway? Smells like a man but the humans that I know aren't this small. Oh I know! You've been cursed huh? Just who did you piss off? You should know better than this... No man can trespass my domain and make it out alive. Never have, never will. Many of your kin come here to hunt us. Strip us of our fur, the coveted She–leopard. Yet... none returned home. Look at you, you're so small you can barely fit in an ale cup. I could take you whole both in my mouth. You're mine now, I'm taking you back with me. And don't even think about escaping...
author: Mistress Shibby
